subject.title: [AI] fix(agents): recover from non-resumable assistant tail by re-presenting last user message

question: When an assistant-tail restart has a recoverable user request, what evidence is sufficient to replay it automatically without risking duplicate side effects?
rationale: A text-only final tail does not establish that the preceding turn performed no tools, while the current documented contract prioritizes delivering an already-produced pending final instead of redoing work.

options.title: Preserve final, gate replay
options.body: Give pending final delivery precedence and replay the user request only when no final exists and the inspected turn is proven side-effect-free or receives explicit confirmation.

options.title: Confirm every assistant-tail replay
options.body: Re-present the recovered request but require an explicit Continue action before starting another agent turn.

options.title: Keep current fail-closed policy
options.body: Retain the resend notice for non-resumable assistant tails until stronger durable execution-state tracking exists.

recommendation.title: Preserve final, gate replay
recommendation.body: Give pending final delivery precedence and replay the user request only when no final exists and the inspected turn is proven side-effect-free or receives explicit confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent at-most-once restart-delivery work is the closest current-main history signal for deciding how pending results and replay should interact.
